content: Rolling out auth/rate-limiting on a shipped API: communicate/version before enforcing, use a shadow/dry-run phase for rate limits to see real impact before rejecting traffic, return 429 with Retry-After, and treat any allowlist/exception as a tracked capacity commitment. For a single first-party client, the main risk collapses to synchronized deploy of client+server so the client sends the new required header/token before the server starts requiring it.
